newsitem.title: USA: THC Homecare to cut operating expenses.
newsitem.headline: THC Homecare to cut operating expenses.

text.p: THC Homecare Inc on Wednesday said it was aiming to cut operating expenses by at least 15 percent by March 31 in an effort to achieve positive cash flow as soon as possible.
The company also hopes to generate a positive cash flow by the end of the first quarter and recapitalize by securing a long-term line of credit.
Toward that end, it said talks have been opened with Heller Financial Services over an extension of its loan.
THC Homecare Inc is a health-care company specializing in durable medical equipment, respiratory services and retail sales outlets for the home care market.
